title: PandamStyle benchmark campaign metadata
description: Everything needed to decide whether two observation files are comparable, and to reproduce a number. Stored SEPARATELY from the observations, because an observation row carries no ambient context and a campaign that only records 'MacBook' cannot be re-checked.

baseline_commit.description: The commit every number in this campaign is relative to.

engines.description: One entry per engine: what it is, where its code lives, the exact commit and tree, and whether the working tree was clean when the run started. A dirty tree disqualifies the run as qualification evidence.

working_tree.description: Reported as found, not as the runner leaves it.

environment.description: Hardware identity precise enough to re-check a number: CPU model and core count, total RAM, kernel, filesystem type, Node/V8/ICU versions, package manager versions, lockfile digest, and the build settings (source maps, minification, target).

warmup_iterations.description: Recorded rather than hidden. Warmup iterations are excluded from measurement explicitly, and the same count applies to every engine. A process-cold scenario is never warmed.

engine_order_randomisation.description: How execution order was decided, and that it is seeded so the same command reproduces the same order.

wall_clock_used_for.description: Wall-clock timestamps are used for event ordering metadata only, never as a duration.

os_cache_state.description: The OS page cache was never dropped: this environment does not grant the privileges, and simulating it would not reproduce a cold cache. Every number is a warm-OS-cache number.

matrix.description: What was asked for. Cells and scenarios that produced no job because a scenario does not declare that cache state are absent here and are listed as not_run in the report.

jobs.description: One entry per job, INCLUDING the failures. A job that crashed or timed out is here with its status, its child's exit code and the observation it produced; it is never removed to improve an average.

wall_ms.description: Whole child process INCLUDING spawn. Recorded separately from startup_ms, which the child measures internally, so the two are never added together.

parse_evidence.description: Relative path to the per-parse evidence document for this job.

observations_sha256.description: Digest of the observation stream this metadata describes.
